issues.where: the whole orbital view, the pale skeleton figure laid over the planet
issues.what: from orbit the ground reads as a white line drawing of a skeleton, with a spiral glyph beside it, stamped on a dark globe; it does not look like a real view of land, sea and cloud from that height, and across 120 frames nothing changes except a small red glow that pulses evenly in the ribs
issues.fix: render the end as real terrain under drifting cloud, with a terminator and atmosphere limb; if the figure must stay, build it from coastlines, ridges and lava fields so it reads as geography, and let the cloud and the glow change unevenly

issues.what: the frame is almost a held still: no camera drift, no cloud motion, no light change, so the climb ends on a dead picture rather than a living planet
issues.fix: keep the pull out going with a slow ease to rest, and let the weather systems and the day-night line move

issues.where: the large pterosaurs near the lens, frames 0 to 22
issues.what: the two big foreground pterosaurs are there at frame 11 and gone by frame 22 with no exit path, so they read as a pop rather than a flyby
issues.fix: carry them out of frame over several more frames, or bank them away behind the left tower

issues.where: the camera, judged by the dark rock at lower left and the cliff edge
issues.what: the camera slides sideways and back over the 8 s loop like a pendulum: the rock leaves frame around loop 174 and returns by 435, a move made to close the loop, not a travel through the place
issues.fix: hold the camera near still with only a slight drift, or move it on a single path and hide the return in a slower ease

issues.where: the surf at the foot of the left tower, frames 44 to 120
issues.what: the white water at the tower base grows steadily and sits as one soft patch; it does not break and fall back between swells
issues.fix: time the spray to the swell crests so it bursts and drains in pulses of different size

issues.where: the far wading animals along the waterline
issues.what: at this size the animals glide along the shore at similar speeds with little sign of pause or turn
issues.fix: give each a different pace, with stops to feed and turns of the head
